gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-cypro-m: Bruno Ace SC spaces its wide letters out like beads on a thread. Noto Sans Cypro Minoan, a plain sans with terminals cut back to leave a big gap, is the lighter counterweight, and that contrast in line weight is what makes the pair.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-: Approachable and modern, Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya shows a visibly gaping c at any size. Over a long stretch it would read loose and friendly, while Bruno Ace SC above it holds its marker-like, constant-width line.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Noto Sans Hatran reads neutral and approachable, with a wide funnel-like throat in the e that welcomes the eye in. Bruno Ace SC adds tube-thick strokes above it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-inscrip: Wide, bold, and pipe-bent. Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi, a plain sans with unclogged small counters, does the quiet reading work, while Bruno Ace SC saves its constant-width strokes for making an entrance.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-javanes: Bruno Ace SC draws everything with blueprint-like constant lines, its open apertures spreading the letters wide. Noto Sans Javanese, a plain sans, keeps its counters connected to the space outside.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Flat, unswelling curves and wide-set letters give Bruno Ace SC its distinctive, expressive look. Noto Sans Kawi, with an open-jawed c like pliers, would read clean and unfussy over pages.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-linear-: Clean and neutral, Noto Sans Linear A shows a gaping c at any size. Bruno Ace SC sits over it with stroke width that never wavers, and that steady line against the lighter body is the pair's strongest quality.

Noto Sans Linear B is a modern plain sans with a smooth, unobstructed path around each bend. Over a long passage it would read quietly and without friction, and Bruno Ace SC supplies the ruler-drawn, constant-width heading line.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-manicha: Noto Sans Manichaean reads modern and clean, its e crossbars open-mouthed. Across a long passage it stays light and easy on the eye, a sharp contrast to Bruno Ace SC, whose diagonals are as stout as its uprights.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-mongoli: Bruno Ace SC draws a ruler-straight line weight and spreads its open letters wide like beads on a thread. It handles the loud, expressive work, while Noto Sans Mongolian, a sans-serif with flaring terminals, handles the reading.
